name: arbiter_of_woe_sacrifice_discard_drain_and_draw
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature. Flying. When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card and loses 2 life. You draw a card and gain 2 life.' Seat 0 casts Arbiter of Woe, sacrificing its 1/1 (its only creature, so no ask); it enters. The opponent discards one of its two cards (the Spare, its choice), keeps the other and loses 2 life; seat 0 draws one card and gains 2 life. Seat 0's hand held only the Arbiter, so it holds the one drawn card.
